 │ ● Measured on Claude 2.1.318 and Codex 0.160.1: in both /model pickers, Enter
 │   SAVES the pick as your default for new sessions (~/.claude/settings.json,
 │   ~/.codex/config.toml); only the picker's `s` key is "this session only".
 │   Claude's `/model <name>` with an argument also saves the default. What
 │   should choosing a model from the chat do?
   → Save as default

 │   API (a `claude -p` initialize sidecar) ran an UNTRUSTED repo's SessionStart
 │   hook in my test (ADR 0001). How should the chat's command list treat MCP
 │   prompts?
   → leave them out for now
